name: cardano-tessera-core
description: Tessera application core: the DataSource read seam, in-memory keyset paging over a full survey list, the list-aggregation adapter, and the read configuration. The HTTP contract lives in cardano-tessera-client and the reusable domain + tally surface in cip-179; both are imported directly, never re-exported here. No I/O, no runtime coupling.
